title: Designed and ran a hands-on code quality workshop for about 50 engineers
summary: I designed and ran a two-hour workshop on design, code, test and review patterns, where engineers reviewed real open-source and shared code knowing they would co-own any bug they approved.
what_would_have_happened: Engineers would keep reviewing code without shared techniques for spotting problems.
the_call: Teach by having engineers review real code together and own what they approve.
what_i_did: Built the review exercises and anti-pattern examples, and led the session in the room and online.
what_changed: About 50 engineers took part, 12 in the room and 38 online. The announcement was seen by 1,103 people, and a leader asked to run these sessions more often.
